name: MeUp WF-08 (Postgres) · Comprobante de egreso → Pago transportista + BANCOS_MOV

parameters.query:
select id_doc as "ID_DOC", ocr_valor as "OCR_VALOR", ocr_fecha_pago as "OCR_FECHA_PAGO",
       ocr_referencia as "OCR_REFERENCIA", ocr_cliente as "OCR_CLIENTE", url_drive as "URL_DRIVE",
       clasificacion as "CLASIFICACION", estado as "ESTADO"
from comprobantes_wa
where clasificacion = 'COMPROBANTE_EGRESO' and estado in ('PROCESADO','SIN_MATCH','REVISAR');

select id_pago as "ID_PAGO", id_solicitud as "ID_SOLICITUD", id_compra as "ID_COMPRA",
       transportista as "TRANSPORTISTA", cedula as "CEDULA", tipo as "TIPO", valor as "VALOR",
       medio_pago as "MEDIO_PAGO", estado as "ESTADO", id_doc_wa as "ID_DOC_WA",
       fecha_pago as "FECHA_PAGO", cuenta_origen as "CUENTA_ORIGEN", pago_neto as "PAGO_NETO"
from transportes_pagos;

update transportes_pagos set
  tipo = $2::text,
  valor = $3::text::numeric,
  fecha_pago = nullif($4::text,'')::date,
  url_comprobante = $5::text,
  estado = 'PAGADO',
  id_doc_wa = nullif($6::text,''),
  notas = $7::text,
  human_review = 'PENDIENTE',
  updated_at = now()
where id_pago = $1::text;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.pago.ID_PAGO, $json.esAbono ? 'ABONO' : $json.pago.TIPO, $json.valorPagado, $json.doc.OCR_FECHA_PAGO, $json.doc.URL_DRIVE, $json.doc.ID_DOC, $json.esAbono ? 'Abono parcial; saldo queda en la solicitud' : 'Pago total'] }}

parameters.query: update transportes_solicitudes set estado = $2::text, updated_at = now() where id_solicitud = $1::text;

update bancos_mov set categoria = 'TRANSPORTE', id_conciliacion = $2::text, updated_at = now()
where id_mov = $1::text;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Gestionar abono / saldo').item.json.j.doc.ID_DOC, $('Preparar registro bancario').item.json.ID_MOV || $('Preparar registro bancario').item.json.fila?.ID_MOV] }}

parameters.query:
update comprobantes_wa set estado = $2::text, notas = $3::text, updated_at = now()
where id_doc = $1::text;
